profile_text.body:
Arthur AI describes itself as an AI governance platform that provides what it calls "one control plane for trustworthy enterprise AI." The company's platform, also named Arthur AI, offers model monitoring and governance capabilities including bias mitigation, fairness metrics, and compliance reporting across the full AI lifecycle. According to its website, Arthur combines security, finance, and AI operations teams on a unified interface for measuring, monitoring, and governing enterprise AI at scale.

The platform includes discovery capabilities to identify AI agents running across endpoints, cloud environments, and data centers, along with Agent Behavioral Analytics that continuously monitors AI applications for anomalous behavior and security indicators. Arthur also provides guardrails and security policies for real-time protection, and cost tracking functionality that automatically detects and reroutes requests to less expensive models, including open-source alternatives. The company positions these capabilities as enabling AI leaders, builders, and security teams to enforce policies and maintain control of AI deployments.
